limitations: CPU profiles and interventions are not pooled with ordinary latency.
Cold board readiness is the first active card, weaker than return readiness.
One early complete baseline has aggregate long-task/frame metrics but no individual arrays; retained as supplemental.
Renderer counters cover readiness plus input and 350ms tail; they overlap.
Request duration and frame samples are recorded in all required ordinary launches. Paths are fixture API paths, without query strings or credentials.
PR detail 500 responses are expected scope gaps for the fixture without a connected forge; connected details are not validated.
No field INP, packaged release, offline failure recovery, loaded agent or feedback claim.
